items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did an album with Kid Ory with the help of Nesuhi Ertegun, who was living in California and knew Ory really well.

ctx.x: Bill Gottlieb is the only other person I know who met him and talked to him.
Yeah. Nesuhi Ertegun met him in Washington and recorded him, actually.
